proof-statement-integrity.evidence: This is a conjecture block, so the Lean is not expected to prove the md claim -- but it previously claimed a stronger epistemic status than it had. The module docstring said the conjecture was 'axiomatised as a Lean class with no instance'. That was FALSE: CPTClosure carried ClosedBraid, markovTrace and cptComposite as FIELDS, so ClosedBraid := Unit, markovTrace := fun _ => 0, cptComposite := id inhabits it and a [CPTClosure R] binder assumed nothing. The class is now parameterised over (B, tr, cpt) and genuinely has no instance. Still open and unproved: each of the three component conjectures -- that the colour-sheet flavour swap, the braid-diagram mirror and Markov-trace word reversal individually preserve tr_M.
proof-statement-integrity.notes: Also: cpt_closure was a def returning inst.cpt_trace_preserved, the conjecture field handed back (AGENTS.md 3b-cond item 5). It is now a named Prop over caller-supplied data, asserting nothing -- AGENTS.md 1a disposition 3. AND one implication became DERIVED: cptClosure_of_components proves that if C, P and T each preserve tr_M then so does C o P o T, which is exactly the md's claim that the three components 'collectively constitute the conjecture'. The md sentence describing the class arity was updated to match. NOTE ON SIDECAR STALENESS: this block measured needs-agent 30 BEFORE the md edit (checked by stashing the change and re-sweeping), so its agent criteria were already carrying no live verdict; the edit did not create that debt. Bean qou-z9ws.
